messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected in ap-southeast1 edge pool (edgepool-23). 5m error rate: 18% (>p95 threshold). Auto-escalation triggered. Paging @jana and @mike.

jana (oncall): I’m on it, ack. Any customer-facing alerts?

incident-bot: Currently degraded: streaming API and chat endpoints through edgepool-23. Observed timeouts from gateway -> backend model proxies. No automatic reroute executed yet; failover policy is 'soft-steer' to eu-west if >20% errors for 10m.

mike (sre): joining. Quick question — is this specific to larger seq lengths? logs show lots of 504s on proxy side. Pushing runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/edgepool-thrash

lee (ingress): seeing connection resets and increased queue depth on the edge proxy. Memory spikes on ingress-nginx pod replicas 2/6. Backoff config looks normal. Dumping pods:
```
kubectl -n ingress get pods -o wide | grep edgepool-23
edge-proxy-0    Running   1/1   10.2.5.12
edge-proxy-1    CrashLoop 0/1   10.2.5.13
edge-proxy-2    Running   1/1   10.2.5.14
```

jana (oncall): crashloop? any OOMs in the pod logs?

lee (ingress): logs show repeated "write: connection reset by peer" followed by a downstream go runtime panic in v1.4.3-proxy. Not OOM. Stacktrace clipped in logs:
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
...
2026-03-15T03:22:11Z ingress/proxy.go:452 handleRequest
```

mike (sre): hmmm. Could be a regression from last night's proxy rollout. deploy-bot, show last rollout for ingress/proxy in ap-southeast1.

deploy-bot: deployment ingress/proxy rolled at 2187620000 by ops-rotations (v1.4.3 -> v1.4.4). Canary completed 40m ago.

ops-rotations: I kicked the rollout. Known change: improved keepalive handling + new connection pooling. We saw a minor spike in env earlier but not crashloops.

tara (support): customers reporting streaming disconnects and failed requests. Ticket triage: 14 P1 customers in APAC with impact, several with realtime chat experiences failing. We should set status page and outbound.

jana (oncall): immediate mitigation: revert the rollout in ap-southeast1 or shift traffic to eu-west while we triage. Preference? Revert is faster if rollout is indeed the cause.

mike (sre): agree — revert edge proxy in ap-southeast1 to v1.4.3. Lee, can you start the revert? If revert not possible quickly, we'll steer traffic.

lee (ingress): starting revert now. Command: `kubectl -n ingress set image deployment/ingress-proxy proxy=registry.redwood/ingress-proxy:v1.4.3 --record`

incident-bot: Revert initiated at 2187645180. Autoscaling/health checks will roll pods over; expected stabilization in ~4-6m.

mike (sre): while revert runs, enable emergency soft-steer so new user sessions prefer eu-west for ap-southeast1 region. Config: `routing.policy.soft_steer: ap-southeast1 -> eu-west weight=0.8`

lee (ingress): steering applied at 2187645200. Running canary checks.

jana (oncall): tara, please post initial incident notice to status.redwood with APAC partial outage tag and note we're reverting a recent edge proxy rollout. Keep wording minimal.

tara (support): Posted: "We are investigating elevated error rates impacting APAC customers' streaming and chat. Mitigation in progress; routing changes and a rollback are underway. More updates in 10 minutes." :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Revert progress: 3/6 pods restarted, 2 currently terminating, 1 crashing. Health checks failing on one node due to liveness probe flapping.

mike (sre): liveness probe flapping — could be probe threshold too aggressive with new code. Set probe failure threshold to 5 temporarily for ingress-proxy in ap-southeast1 to avoid premature restarts while container stabilizes.

lee (ingress): patching deployment to adjust liveness: `kubectl -n ingress patch deployment ingress-proxy --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"proxy","livenessProbe":{"failureThreshold":5}}]}}}}'`

incident-bot: Liveness patch applied at 2187645260. Rolling pods continuing.

jana (oncall): monitoring metrics. Error rate dropping from 18% -> 7% over 6 minutes. Good sign. Any new 5xx patterns?

mike (sre): 502s still present but decreasing. Heap growth correlated with v1.4.4 observed in canary logs. We'll continue rollback, keep steering until error rate <1% for 10m.

lee (ingress): rollback completed at 2187645310. All pods running v1.4.3 and passing readiness checks.

incident-bot: Routing steer removed at 2187645320 (weight restored). Monitoring for regression. Current 5m error rate: 0.9%. Latency normalized.

jana (oncall): great. tara, reach out to top 5 impacted customers with a short note and mention root cause is a recent proxy release causing connection panics; mitigation: rollback and routing adjustments. Offer to follow up with postmortem.

tara (support): Will do. Drafting messages and opening 1:1 tickets for the P1s.

mike (sre): next steps: collect core dumps and proxy logs from crashed pods for v1.4.4. Create an eval for release gating to add mem/stack regression checks. I'll own the postmortem and RCA.

jana (oncall): handing off to mike for RCA and to ops-rotations for release control. I'll de-escalate oncall in 30m unless we see regressions.

ops-rotations: noted. We'll pause further ingress/proxy rollouts in all regions until postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident: ap-southeast1-edgepool partial outage — mitigated. Severity: Sev2. Start: 2187645123. End (mitigation): 2187645320.

mike (sre): logging action items:
- collect logs and cores from edge-proxy v1.4.4 (lee)
- add regression test to release pipeline for connection stability (mike)
- update runbook to include soft-steer steps and liveness tuning (jana)
- customer outreach complete (tara)

jana (oncall): thanks team. Closing thread for now. Will reopen if error rate bumps above 2% again. :white_check_mark:
